svg.text: Girlboss | Content Strategist at Coastal Networks Holdings

text.tspan: I spent an afternoon unblocking someone
instead of polishing slides.
We kept optimizing a workflow that should have
been deleted.
I stopped mid-sentence when I realized I was
restating what they already knew.
A good retro names the system, not the
scapegoat.
Writing things down is not bureaucracy. It is
respect.
We missed a deadline because I assumed silence
meant agreement.
My job includes removing friction other people
cannot see.
We missed a deadline because I assumed silence
meant agreement.
The quietest person in the room often has the
missing constraint.
I asked for honesty and then defended myself
for the first ten minutes.
Speed without clarity just creates expensive
rework.
Two people on the team had been carrying
context that never made it into the doc.
Ownership without authority is just anxiety
with a title.
The meeting ended when we named the tradeoff
instead of searching for consensus.
Protecting focus time is part of delivering,
not a personal luxury.
I asked for honesty and then defended myself
for the first ten minutes.
Clarify the definition of done before you
celebrate starting.
We missed a deadline because I assumed silence
meant agreement.
Ownership without authority is just anxiety
with a title.
The meeting ended when we named the tradeoff
instead of searching for consensus.
